1.en_consolidated_definition: Cuba and P.Rico. A wading bird with a gray plumage, white rump, belly, and tail, reddish legs, bill, and eyelids.

reference_definitions: . Cuba y P. Rico. Ave palmípeda de plumaje ceniciento, rabadilla, vientre y cola blancos, patas, pico y párpados rojizos.

2.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 4 m de altura, hojas pinnadas, inflorescencia terminal, colgante, formada por numerosas umbelas y fruto subgloboso. (Araliaceae, Polyscias guilfoylei).
2.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching up to 4 m in height, pinnate leaves, terminal inflorescence, pendulous, formed by numerous umbels and subglobose fruit (Araliaceae, Polyscias guilfoylei).
